details: Bitcoin rebounded above $84,000 following reports that the U.S. and Iran are exploring a phased plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. While this eases geopolitical tensions, uncertainty remains as no concrete deal has been reached. Inflation concerns from high energy prices and potential Fed rate hikes continue to influence market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds on US-Iran Talks Amid Hormuz Strait Reopening Hopes

details: Ondo Finance has launched "Ondo Intelligent Portfolios," a new suite of three onchain portfolio tokens (BLKHIon, BLKDIGon, BLKGRWon) built on BlackRock model strategies. This initiative allows non-U.S. investors to access tokenized equities and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) on Ethereum and BNB Chain, contributing to a more than 20% surge in ONDO's price.
title: Ondo Finance Unveils BlackRock-Backed Tokenized Portfolios

details: The Federal Reserve has introduced two proposed rules to implement the GENIUS Act for stablecoin issuers under its supervision. These regulations require stablecoins to be fully backed by permissible reserve assets like short-term U.S. Treasuries, establish capital requirements and risk management standards, and mandate a two-business-day redemption standard.
title: Federal Reserve Proposes New Stablecoin Rules Under GENIUS Act

details: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest has tokenized its $1.3 billion ARK Venture Fund (ARKVX) on the Ethereum blockchain through a partnership with Securitize. This landmark move makes the actively managed fund, which includes strategic stakes in prominent technology companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Stripe, accessible to eligible investors via tokenized shares.
title: ARK Invest Tokenizes $1.3B Venture Fund on Ethereum

details: New York's Attorney General has filed a lawsuit against the prediction market platform Polymarket, accusing it of operating an unlicensed, illegal gambling operation that poses financial risks to New Yorkers. In response, Polymarket has launched its own lawsuit, asserting that the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) holds exclusive regulatory authority over such markets.
title: New York Sues Polymarket, Alleges Illegal Gambling Operation

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have turned net positive for 2026 for the first time since April, propelled by approximately $4.6 billion in inflows since August 19. A significant four-day inflow streak recently contributed $2.31 billion, with BlackRock's IBIT leading the charge. This reversal indicates a renewed institutional interest and a potential floor under Bitcoin's price.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Erase 2026 Outflows with $4.6B Inflow Rebound

details: Raiffeisen Bank International (RBI) is partnering with Austrian crypto infrastructure provider Bitpanda to roll out cryptocurrency trading services to approximately 18 million customers across 11 Central and Eastern European markets. This expansion builds on an existing collaboration, integrating digital asset services directly into banking applications to meet growing customer demand.
title: Raiffeisen Bank to Offer Crypto Trading to 18 Million Customers

details: Stellar's XLM token experienced a price increase following BVNK's integration of the Stellar blockchain into its stablecoin payments platform. This development enables businesses to utilize Stellar for efficient cross-border payments across more than 130 markets globally. This integration also comes after Mastercard's acquisition of BVNK and a U.S. Bank pilot using a Stellar-based stablecoin.
title: Stellar XLM Rises as BVNK Integrates for Global Payments

details: Blockchain.com and NYSE Group have signed an agreement to explore providing 24/7 access to tokenized U.S. stocks and ETFs for Blockchain.com's global user base through NYSE's planned digital trading venue. This collaboration aims to merge traditional finance with blockchain technology and includes a two-way market data exchange.
title: Blockchain.com & NYSE Explore 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading
